title: Words
summary: New words met on cards, then asked by cards that harden as they are known, with a memory round to end.
description: The first drill for a handful of new words: meet each one, then recall it.

requirements.text: A words lesson shows each new word on a card and then asks it by multiple choice, before the words met before, which come in a shuffled order.
Where speaking cards are on, a words lesson asks at most one known word to be said aloud, when its familiarity and level reach saying it.

history.text: Where speaking cards are on and at least three of its words have been answered before, a words lesson asks one of them to be said aloud instead of practised.
history.reason: Saying a word aloud is now a step of the word's ladder from B1, not a card any known word can get.

requirements.text: A words lesson ends with a memory round of its words, when they make at least `memory.pairs-min` pairs.
A course's new words are cut into lessons of `drill.words-max`, every third of them a typing lesson and the rest words lessons.
